title: Esrbespoke
description: A coachbuilder's monochrome: pure white paper and pure black ink, black full-bleed sections and a charcoal page tone, one pale grey for hairlines and resting list items, one mid grey for secondary labels. A slightly wide neo-grotesk (Mona Sans at 500) for every headline, statement and list item over tiny tracked capitals in a squarish label face (Saira). Square corners (2px chips), no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is its sibling (black paper, white ink, rgb 25 charcoal cards, rgb 43 chips)
the label face is set as --typeface-mono (font-mono): tiny all-caps labels, nav and figures use it
the original's charcoal pages (careers, privacy) are the dark scope plus bg-card
muted is the placeholder grey and the resting colour of inactive marques; border is ink at 10%
gutter is 18px on phones and 32px from 1024px; content runs the full window width (page-width 120rem)
